missionSuccessStatementOverride: You did something useful for a change.
badFaithStatementOverride: Typical performance from a sub-par unit.
goodFaithStatementOverride: You can;t even do the simple things right, can you?
shortDescription: I don't have time to micro-manage you and need intelligence. Get out across the front and see what's there so my Rangers can do the real work.
longDescription: No intel, so we need to generate the intel. This will end well.

objectiveList.title: Destroy All Buildings Within the Objective Zone
objectiveList.description: The objective counts the structures inside the mark. Destroy them all.

objectiveList.title: Reach Waypoint 1 in 9 rounds with your entire lance
Reach Waypoint 2 in 12 rounds with your entire lance
Get to the dust-off in 7 rounds
Reach Waypoint 3 in 14 rounds with your entire lance

dialogueContent.words: The Vegan Rangers have marked the route they want us to patrol, Commander. Make sure that you hit every waypoint before you run out of time. Do not linger at any point and get to the first waypoint as quickly as you can.
Clock's half gone, Commander. Get to the next waypoint.
One round left to reach the next waypoint, Commander.
Waypoint One is ahead. Move quickly. Don't forget that Nelson will be watching us.
Waypoint two is ahead. Clock is now ticking and I am getting pressure from the VEgans to get you through this patrol quickly.
Waypoint three is up next. don't mess around.
Destroy the buildings within the objective area and get to Waypoint 4.
Dropship is inbound. Get to the dust-off location and see if you can shake any enemy units that are still on your tail.
We took too long, Commander, and Colonel Nelson is already on the radio howling at me.
That's it, commander, you've completed the patrol. Not that Colonel Nelson seems to really care.
I imagine this is going to be quite the ugly debrief.
